description: Searches Praetorium’s missions, force dispositions, deployments, terrain, rules, detachments, and datasheets by name, number, keyword, and value, then datasheets and detachments whose abilities, stratagems or enhancements say the words searched for, such as objective control remains for an ability that keeps an objective. Returns bounded excerpts with canonical URLs, source revisions, and attribution; a match found by what an ability says names that ability and points at its section. A result whose section is a rule carries its ruleSummary: Praetorium’s own wording of the rule, never the official text.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

query.description: A name, a printed rule number, an ability, a weapon, or a keyword.

name: search_reference

ruleSummary.description: Praetorium’s own wording of the rule, in Markdown: a summary written for Praetorium, not the official text. A Stratagem’s summary written in parts also gives its when, target, effect and restrictions apart.

textSources.description: Where withheld rules text lives upstream, given only where Praetorium has no summary of the rule: the pinned file, its source, and the id of the record holding it there when the file has one.

title: Search the Praetorium game reference
